# Data Dashboard and Reporting Service Planner

## Purpose
Help a freelancer define a useful reporting deliverable without inventing metrics or connecting to live data.

## Workflow
1. Capture the decisions the dashboard should support and the intended audience.
2. Inventory client-approved data sources, owners, refresh cadence, and known limitations.
3. Define each metric with formula, unit, time zone, filters, and source lineage.
4. Identify missing data, duplicate records, inconsistent definitions, and reconciliation requirements.
5. Specify visual summaries, drill-downs, export formats, accessibility, and mobile requirements.
6. Define validation checks, stale-data warnings, access controls, and privacy constraints.
7. Estimate implementation and maintenance effort from explicit assumptions and prepare sign-off criteria.

## Output
Metric dictionary, source map, dashboard wireframe description, validation matrix, access checklist, and delivery estimate.

## Safety and limits
- Use synthetic or client-authorized sample data only.
- Do not connect accounts, export live records, or expose personal information.
- Never fabricate results or infer causation from correlation.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

CEOAI-authored workflow. Reporting design only.
